schedule: always-on daemon (FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8770) started by the stream watchdog like the other daemons
notes: Server-cluster builder (python -m server_cluster.builder): the resident FastAPI API entry over the builds.* area's cmds — POST /jobs/run (detached spawn of any builds.* module, tag-deduped), /jobs/status + /jobs/result (service-log tail), /jobs/{tag}/stop. No residents (builds.* are one-shot batch pipelines). The server process never imports pipeline packages — children run detached with output appended to logs/<date>/<module>.log; orphaned children are re-adopted at startup from open monitor.service_audit rows. One instance only — the registration guard auto-exits a second run.
